items.label: Bitcoin
items.blurb: The original chain. UTXO based, so the wallet needs its own address and coin handling.

items.label: Ethereum
items.blurb: Smart contract chain. Unlocks tokens, NFTs, DeFi and every L2 in the list.

items.label: Solana
items.blurb: Fast and cheap, with its own SPL token standard and its own address format.

items.label: XRP
items.blurb: Payment focused ledger with built in destination tags for exchanges.

items.label: Cardano
items.blurb: UTXO smart contract chain with native staking baked into the protocol.

items.label: Dogecoin
items.blurb: Cheap transfers, huge retail recognition, very simple to support.

items.label: Litecoin
items.blurb: Bitcoin style chain with faster blocks. Shares most of the BTC code path.

items.label: BNB Chain
items.blurb: EVM chain with low fees and a deep retail token market.

items.label: Avalanche
items.blurb: EVM compatible with subnets, so app specific chains are easy to add later.

items.label: Polkadot
items.blurb: Parachain hub. Adding it opens the door to the whole Substrate family.

items.label: Cosmos
items.blurb: IBC lets one integration reach dozens of app chains.

items.label: TON
items.blurb: Telegram's chain. Pairs naturally with a Telegram mini app front end.

items.label: Tron
items.blurb: Carries an enormous share of USDT transfers, especially for remittances.

items.label: Sui
items.blurb: Object model chain with sponsored transactions built in.

items.label: Aptos
items.blurb: Move language chain, fast finality, growing payments footprint.

items.label: NEAR
items.blurb: Human readable account names instead of hex addresses.

items.label: Stellar
items.blurb: Built for cheap cross border payments and asset issuance.

items.label: Monero
items.blurb: Private by default. Needs its own view key handling and its own node policy.

items.label: Zcash
items.blurb: Optional shielded transfers using zero knowledge proofs.

items.label: Chainlink
items.blurb: ERC-20, so it arrives free with Ethereum token support.

items.label: Polygon
items.blurb: Cheap EVM chain, very common first stop for new users.

items.label: USDC
items.blurb: Regulated dollar stablecoin. The default unit of account for most wallets.

items.label: USDT
items.blurb: The most traded stablecoin worldwide, biggest on Tron and Ethereum.

items.label: DAI
items.blurb: Crypto collateralized dollar with no company able to freeze it.

items.label: Euro stablecoin
items.blurb: A euro denominated unit for European users who do not think in dollars.

items.label: Memecoins
items.blurb: Long tail tokens. Needs a scam filter and a token metadata source to stay usable.

items.label: Any ERC-20 token
items.blurb: Paste a contract address and the token shows up with its icon and price.

items.label: NFTs and collectibles
items.blurb: Media heavy assets, so they get their own tab rather than sitting in the token list.

items.label: Tokenized real world assets
items.blurb: Tokenized treasuries and funds, usually with a permissioned transfer check.

items.label: Ethereum mainnet
items.blurb: Settlement layer. Expensive, so most wallets pair it with an L2.

items.label: Base
items.blurb: Coinbase's L2. Cheap, and the easiest on-ramp path for US users.

items.label: Arbitrum
items.blurb: Largest L2 by DeFi liquidity.

items.label: Optimism
items.blurb: OP Stack L2, shares tooling with Base.

items.label: zkSync / Linea / Scroll
items.blurb: Zero knowledge rollups with native account abstraction support.

items.label: Polygon PoS
items.blurb: Very cheap EVM chain with strong gaming and payments use.

items.label: Bitcoin Lightning
items.blurb: Instant sub-cent Bitcoin payments. Needs channel or LSP management.

items.label: Bitcoin L2 (Liquid, Rootstock)
items.blurb: Sidechains that add confidential transfers or contracts to Bitcoin.

items.label: Cosmos IBC zones
items.blurb: One integration, many app chains, with native cross chain transfers.

items.label: Testnets
items.blurb: A network switcher with faucets, for people who want to try before funding.

items.label: Custom RPC networks
items.blurb: Users paste a chain ID and RPC URL and the wallet supports it immediately.

items.label: Self custody with a seed phrase
items.blurb: The classic model. Twelve or twenty four words, written down, full control and full responsibility.

items.label: MPC keyless (no seed phrase)
items.blurb: The key is split into shares that never meet. Users sign in with a passkey or email and still hold a share.

items.label: Smart account (account abstraction)
items.blurb: The account is a contract, which unlocks sponsored gas, batching, session keys and recovery rules.

items.label: Hardware first
items.blurb: Keys never leave a signing device. The app becomes a watch and broadcast layer.

items.label: Multisig vault
items.blurb: Several signers must approve. The right answer for treasuries, partners and large balances.

items.label: Custodial (you hold the keys for users)
items.blurb: Simplest for newcomers, but it makes you a regulated party in most places.

items.label: Hybrid: custodial start, self custody upgrade
items.blurb: Users start with training wheels and export to full self custody when they are ready.

items.label: Biometric unlock
items.blurb: Face or fingerprint to open the app and to confirm spending.

items.label: PIN or password
items.blurb: A local secret, the baseline for anything on a phone.

items.label: Passkeys
items.blurb: Phishing resistant sign-in backed by the device secure element.

items.label: Two factor for sensitive actions
items.blurb: A second factor on withdrawals, exports and new device logins.

items.label: Social recovery
items.blurb: Chosen guardians can restore access without ever seeing the key.

items.label: Split backup (Shamir shares)
items.blurb: The backup is split into pieces, any threshold of them restores it.

items.label: Encrypted cloud backup
items.blurb: An encrypted blob in the user's own cloud, unlocked by a password only they know.

items.label: Hardware wallet pairing
items.blurb: Pair a signing device for large balances while keeping the same interface.

items.label: Transaction simulation
items.blurb: Shows exactly what leaves the wallet before the user signs. The single best scam defence.

items.label: Scam and spam token filter
items.blurb: Hides hostile airdrops and flags known drainer contracts and lookalike domains.

items.label: Address allowlist
items.blurb: Funds can only leave to addresses approved earlier, with a cooling off delay.

items.label: Spending limits
items.blurb: Per day or per transaction caps that need a stronger approval to exceed.

items.label: Time locked withdrawals
items.blurb: Large transfers wait, and the user can cancel during the window.

items.label: Token approval manager
items.blurb: Lists every contract that can move funds and revokes them in one tap.

items.label: Duress mode and hidden wallets
items.blurb: A second PIN opens a decoy wallet holding a small balance.

items.label: Auto lock and screenshot block
items.blurb: Locks on background and stops the balance appearing in screenshots or app switchers.

items.label: Third party audit and bug bounty
items.blurb: An external review plus a standing bounty. Table stakes for anything holding real money.

items.label: Open source and reproducible builds
items.blurb: Anyone can verify the shipped app matches the published code.

items.label: Inheritance plan
items.blurb: If the wallet goes untouched for a chosen period, a nominated person gains access.

items.label: Air gapped signing
items.blurb: Sign on a device that never touches the internet, passing QR codes back and forth.

items.label: Send and receive
items.blurb: The floor. Address, QR, amount, fee choice, confirmation.

items.label: In-app swap
items.blurb: Best price routing across exchanges without leaving the wallet.

items.label: Cross chain bridge
items.blurb: Move assets between chains, ideally hidden behind a single swap screen.

items.label: Staking
items.blurb: Earn protocol rewards directly, with clear unbonding times.

items.label: DeFi earn and vaults
items.blurb: Curated yield strategies with the risk stated in plain language.

items.label: Borrow against holdings
items.blurb: Take a stablecoin loan without selling, with a visible liquidation line.

items.label: NFT gallery
items.blurb: Grid view, traits, floor price, and a send flow that shows the artwork.

items.label: dApp browser
items.blurb: An in-app browser with the wallet injected, plus a curated app list.

items.label: WalletConnect
items.blurb: Scan a QR to sign into any app on desktop.

items.label: Buy with card or bank
items.blurb: Card, bank transfer or Apple Pay, with the provider chosen per country.

items.label: Sell to bank
items.blurb: The exit route. Often the deciding feature for non-crypto natives.

items.label: Crypto debit card
items.blurb: Spend balances anywhere, with the conversion happening at the till.

items.label: Portfolio and P&L
items.blurb: Total value over time, cost basis, and per asset performance.

items.label: Price alerts
items.blurb: Push notifications on price moves, incoming funds and governance votes.

items.label: Recurring buys (DCA)
items.blurb: Automatic buys on a schedule, the least stressful way to accumulate.

items.label: Limit orders
items.blurb: Set a price and let it fill while the app is closed.

items.label: Address book
items.blurb: Named contacts with a per contact note, so nobody pastes an address twice.

items.label: Usernames and ENS
items.blurb: Send to alice.eth instead of a forty character string.

items.label: QR and tap to pay
items.blurb: Point of sale style payments face to face.

items.label: Payment requests and invoices
items.blurb: A shareable link or QR with the amount and reason baked in.

items.label: Split bills with friends
items.blurb: Group tabs that settle in one transaction.

items.label: Sponsored gas / gas tank
items.blurb: Users pay fees in the token they hold, or you cover them entirely.

items.label: Batched transactions
items.blurb: Approve and swap in a single confirmation instead of two.

items.label: Session keys
items.blurb: Scoped permissions so a game or bot can act without asking every time.

items.label: Multiple accounts and folders
items.blurb: Separate spending, savings and experiments without switching apps.

items.label: Watch only wallets
items.blurb: Track a cold wallet or a friend's address without any keys.

items.label: Rich transaction history
items.blurb: Human readable activity: swapped, staked, minted, not just hashes.

items.label: Tax and CSV export
items.blurb: Cost basis reports and a clean export for an accountant.

items.label: DAO governance voting
items.blurb: See proposals and vote or delegate from the wallet.

items.label: Airdrop and rewards tracker
items.blurb: Shows what the connected addresses qualify for and what is unclaimed.

items.label: Token radar and trending
items.blurb: What is moving right now, with liquidity and holder checks attached.

items.label: On-chain alerts and whale watch
items.blurb: Follow interesting addresses and get pinged when they move.

items.label: Market news feed
items.blurb: A short daily brief tied to the assets actually held.

items.label: Learn and earn tutorials
items.blurb: Short lessons that pay a tiny reward, the best converter for first time users.

items.label: Savings goals and round ups
items.blurb: Spare change from card spending sweeps into a savings pot.

items.label: Family and kid accounts
items.blurb: Supervised accounts with limits and an approval step for the adult.

items.label: Business treasury tools
items.blurb: Roles, policies, cost centres and an export your accountant will accept.

items.label: Payroll and mass payouts
items.blurb: Pay a list of people in one signed batch, with receipts.

items.label: Remittances and FX
items.blurb: Local currency in, local currency out, with the crypto rail invisible.

items.label: Merchant and checkout tools
items.blurb: Take payments as a business, with settlement to stablecoins or bank.

items.label: Tipping and creator payouts
items.blurb: One tap tips to a handle, with a public tip page.

items.label: Gaming and in-game assets
items.blurb: Fast signing, session keys and an inventory view instead of a token list.

items.label: Encrypted chat and pay by handle
items.blurb: Message a contact and attach money to the message.

items.label: Home screen widgets
items.blurb: Balance and price at a glance without opening the app.

items.label: Voice and accessibility
items.blurb: Screen reader labels, large type and voice confirmation of amounts.

items.label: Multi language and local currency
items.blurb: Display in the user's language and their home currency, not just USD.

items.label: In-app human support
items.blurb: A real person reachable from inside the app, with the context attached.

items.label: Built-in AI copilot
items.blurb: Explains transactions, warns about risk and answers questions in plain language.

items.label: Bill pay and top ups
items.blurb: Pay utilities or top up a phone straight from the balance.

items.label: Token launchpad
items.blurb: Create or join token launches with vesting and lock rules.

items.label: Vault mode for long term holding
items.blurb: A locked down profile with no browser, no swaps, and deliberate friction.

items.label: iOS app
items.blurb: Face ID, secure enclave, widgets and Apple Pay on-ramp.

items.label: Android app
items.blurb: Widest global reach, especially in emerging markets.

items.label: Web app
items.blurb: Nothing to install. Pairs best with MPC or passkey custody.

items.label: Browser extension
items.blurb: Where desktop DeFi actually happens.

items.label: Desktop app
items.blurb: Room for pro layouts, multiple accounts and hardware devices.

items.label: Telegram mini app
items.blurb: Zero install distribution inside a chat, huge for TON and referrals.

items.label: Watch app
items.blurb: Balance glance and payment confirmation on the wrist.

items.label: Display glasses
items.blurb: Projected interface for smart glasses using the Glimmer toolkit.

items.label: Your own hardware device
items.blurb: A dedicated signer you ship yourself. Serious project, serious moat.

items.label: Developer API and SDK
items.blurb: Let other products embed the wallet. This is where B2B revenue lives.

items.label: No KYC for self custody
items.blurb: No identity check to hold or send. On-ramps still verify, so keep them optional.

items.label: Tor or proxy routing
items.blurb: Requests do not leak the user's IP to indexers.

items.label: Own node / private RPC
items.blurb: Balances are not queried through a third party that logs everything.

items.label: Coin control and labels
items.blurb: Choose which coins to spend so histories are not linked.

items.label: Stealth addresses
items.blurb: A fresh receiving address per payment, automatically.

items.label: No analytics, no tracking
items.blurb: No third party SDKs watching what users hold.

items.label: Local only history
items.blurb: Transaction history and labels stay encrypted on the device.

items.label: Zero knowledge proof of funds
items.blurb: Prove you hold enough without revealing the balance or the address.

items.label: Calm and minimal
items.blurb: Quiet type, lots of space, nothing shouting.

items.label: Neon and cyber
items.blurb: High contrast, glowing accents, made for night use.

items.label: Glass and gradient
items.blurb: Soft blurred panels over colour.

items.label: Bold and blocky
items.blurb: Thick borders, hard shadows, unmistakable.

items.label: Glimmer (XR optimized)
items.blurb: Projected UI for smart glasses. High contrast, floating panels, spatial layout.

items.label: Playful
items.blurb: Rounded shapes and warm colour, aimed at first timers.
